tha-ap510:1.1: Amoraphaliya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ / rathiyaṃ paṭipajjantaṃ amoram adadaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap510:2.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap510:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Amoraphaliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
